model.note: Weights fit by backtest/backtest.py on points vs league average; learn.py updates them weekly when the guardrails pass. fatigue.* are the points each schedule spot adds to the 0-100 fatigue index. projection.*: fatigueK = share of points a fully tired team (index 100) loses; oppFatigueK = share gained against a fully tired defense; availK = points lost per unit of scoring share missing beyond the typical availBase; shrink = how much of the raw projection's spread is kept (fit as the slope of actual on projected); sdTeam/sdGame = spread of actual points around the projection, for under chances.

history.why: First backtest (2022-23 to 2025-26, 9,842 team-games): offense, opponent defense and pace carry most of the ranking of points vs league average; rest and availability add a little; nothing beats the closing line on its own.
